description:
**Présentation de l’entreprise**
 Brother est un chef de file d’équipements pour la maison et le bureau, de produits de couture et de loisirs créatifs, ainsi que de solutions industrielles. Avec plus de 115 ans d'histoire, notre marque est reconnue pour ses imprimantes primées, ses machines à coudre, ses étiqueteuses P\-touch et bien plus encore. Brother Canada, a été fondée en1960, marquant plus de 65 ans d’activités. L’entreprise a son siège social à Dollard\-des\-Ormeaux, au Québec, et est une filiale à part entière de Brother International Corporation (BIC), basée aux États\-Unis. BIC est elle\-même une filiale de Brother Industries Limited (BIL), fondée en 1908 à Nagoya, au Japon, et présente dans plus de 30 pays à travers le monde.
   

  

**Pourquoi travailler chez Brother ?**
 Chez Brother Canada, nous sommes bien plus qu’une équipe : nous formons une communauté guidée par les moteurs de notre culture : la responsabilité, l’authenticité, l’excellence et l’audace. Nous favorisons la collaboration, la croissance et l’équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et la vie personnelle en proposant à notre personnel des horaires flexibles, des possibilités de travail hybride, des subventions de santé, des rabais, ainsi que des programmes de formation, de perfectionnement et de reconnaissance. Présents à Montréal depuis 1960, nous valorisons l’amélioration continue et encourageons le dépassement de soi, tout en assurant votre stabilité et en offrant une expérience client exceptionnelle.
   

  

**Aperçu du rôle**
 Relevant du directeur de l’analyse des données et des connaissances, l’analyste de données contribue à faciliter et à accélérer la prise de décisions fondées sur des données et la science. Mettant à profit les résultats d’analyses rigoureuses, vous fournirez des renseignements fiables, pertinents et à jour pour orienter les activités commerciales et les initiatives stratégiques de l’entreprise, ainsi que les tactiques de mise en marché. Vous veillerez à répondre aux exigences des clients à l’interne et à assurer l’excellence opérationnelle.
   

  

 Travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les autres membres de l’équipe d’analyse, vous créerez et tiendrez à jour des outils et des processus qui facilitent la manipulation et la transformation des données sur plusieurs plateformes. Vous participerez à l’automatisation des processus et à l’intégration des principes de la science des données en vue d’améliorer les processus de prise de décision. Vous rencontrerez diverses parties prenantes afin de comprendre leurs exigences commerciales en vue de les traduire en exigences techniques, de réaliser des projets de développement et d’en tester les fonctionnalités. De plus, vous répondrez aux demandes ad hoc, mettrez en œuvre des procédures opérationnelles normalisées liées aux données et gérerez les attentes des parties prenantes tout au long du processus. Dans le cadre de vos responsabilités en matière de veille stratégique, vous produirez des rapports et des tableaux de bord, les tiendrez à jour et y apporterez des améliorations. Enfin, vous contribuerez à améliorer l’expérience du client et déterminerez, planifierez et mettrez en œuvre les efforts d’amélioration continue.
   

  

**Tâches et responsabilités**
 Analyse et production de rapports
   

  

* 
+ Comprendre et cerner les besoins commerciaux des parties prenantes afin d’analyser et d’effectuer le suivi du rendement de leurs activités.
+ Recueillir de l’information sur les exigences des parties prenantes et préparer de la documentation en fonction de celles\-ci.
+ Élaborer un cahier des charges définissant les méthodes d’analyse, les échéanciers, les rôles et responsabilités et le format des livrables afin de favoriser la participation des parties prenantes.
+ Créer de nouveaux formats de rapports et des tableaux de bord dans Tableau, les améliorer et les tenir à jour.
+ Générer des informations pertinentes et fiables en élaborant des méthodes d’analyse et en réalisant des projets d’analyse reproductibles qui génèrent des résultats significatifs d’un point de vue statistique.
+ Répondre aux demandes de rapports et d’analyses ad hoc.
+ Rédiger des mises à jour afin de communiquer l’état d’avancement des projets.


 Gestion des données et assurance de la qualité
   

  

* 
+ Élaborer des processus de manipulation, de transformation et d’extraction d’ensembles de données provenant de différentes sources à l’aide de Python et Pandas pour en tirer des informations.
+ Effectuer le dépistage de panne et des activités d’analyse des causes profondes pour résoudre les problèmes techniques et recommander des solutions évolutives.
+ Générer, tenir à jour et améliorer l’entonnoir d’extraction, de transformation et de chargement des données (ETC).
+ Migrer les bases de données des serveurs locaux vers des entrepôts de données en nuage (AWS, Azure Databricks).
+ Transformer, remanier et déployer des modèles ETC et des modèles d’apprentissage automatique pour la production dans un système virtuel ou en nuage (AWS, Azure Databricks).
+ Regrouper de grands ensembles de données provenant de diverses sources pour effectuer des analyses prescriptives et prédictives.
+ Repérer les problèmes d’intégrité des données et mettre en œuvre les procédures d’assurance de la qualité.


**Expérience Et Qualifications**
* 
+ Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, économie, informatique, analyse, ingénierie informatique, systèmes d’information, mathématiques ou statistiques appliquées, ou tout autre domaine connexe.
+ Maîtrise en administration des affaires (MBA), en sciences (M. Sc.), en analytique de gestion (MMA), ou autre domaine connexe, un atout.
+ De 1 à 3 ans d’expérience dans un poste d’analyse.
+ Expérience pratique avec les statistiques et les méthodes de recherche (quantitatives et qualitatives).
+ Capacité à analyser des résultats et à les communiquer de façon éloquente.
+ Capacité à analyser de grands ensembles de données provenant de sources multiples au moyen d’outils et de méthodes d’analyse de base de données efficaces.
+ Capacité avérée à comprendre les besoins des services de l’entreprise et à établir des partenariats fructueux avec des équipes multifonctionnelles (parties prenantes techniques et non techniques).
+ Connaissance approfondie de Python, SQL, etc.
+ Connaissance des bibliothèques ML de Python, telles que Sci\-kit Learn et TensorFlow.
+ Expérience avec des outils de gestion de mégadonnées, comme Apache Spark, Pandas et Polars.
+ Connaissance de systèmes en nuage, comme AWS et Azur, et d’outils de développement, comme Git, Bash et, un atout.
+ Connaissance approfondie des bases de données relationnelles SQL et NoSQL, dont MySQL, et capacité à formuler et à manipuler des requêtes complexes.
+ Connaissance de Tableau.
+ Personne soucieuse des détails, motivée et efficace.
+ Capacité à faire preuve de souplesse et à s’adapter rapidement à un environnement en constante évolution.
+ Capacité à travailler dans un environnement sous pression et à respecter des contraintes de temps.


**Informations supplémentaires pour ce poste**
 Environnement de travail hybride – Profitez d’un modèle hybride offrant trois jours en télétravail et deux jours au bureau chaque semaine, favorisant l’équilibre travail\-vie personnelle et la collaboration en personne. Des exceptions peuvent s’appliquer selon les besoins de l’entreprise. \#atyourside

The role provides a unique opportunity to work across AI, quantitative research and investing, supporting both the fundamental and systematic investment processes.
 



  





 Strong academics in software engineering, computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, quantitative finance, mathematics, statistics, physics or actuarial science are required. Advanced degrees (MSc/PhD) are welcome but not required.
 



  





 Hands\-on experience with AI tooling, quantitative research, data science, software engineering or financial markets is highly desirable.

 Research and integrate alpha signals (traditional and alternative data), develop predictive models and systematic investment approaches, and contribute to portfolio construction frameworks with a focus on robustness, implementation realism and measurable investment outcomes.
 



  





 About you:

* Deep familiarity with modern AI\-assisted development workflows and coding copilots e.g. Claude Code (preferred), Codex, Copilot or similar. Non\-negotiable.

 We value:

 **Head of Product**

 You'll be the person who makes AI real at Datacom — for our clients, our teams, and our business. That means bringing people with you, building products that actually sell, and knowing enough about the technology to call a bad idea what it is.
   

  

 If you thrive in complexity, love people as much as you love technology, and want to build something that matters — read on.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 Product \& Go\-To\-Market — Build Things That Actually Sell
   

  

 There's no shortage of AI Ideas at Datacom. What we need is someone who can take the best of those ideas and turn them into products that win in the market — products that our own teams want to put into projects for our external customers as well as for our internal work.
   

  

**Building Commercial AI Products**
* Lead the development of Datacom's AI product portfolio — from the first whiteboard session through to commercial launch and iteration
* Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to shape offerings that are genuinely differentiated — not just features dressed up as products
* Define clear value propositions that resonate with buyers — focused on outcomes, not technology for technology's sake
* Build the business case rigour that gives the organisation confidence to invest — and the commercial model that makes it worth investing in


**Winning in the Market**
* Deeply understand the ANZ AI market — where it is now, where it's going, and where Datacom has a genuine right to win
* Shape go\-to\-market strategies that are realistic, targeted, and built on customer insight rather than internal assumption
* Identify the verticals — Government, Health, Financial Services, Retail — where Datacom's AI products will land hardest and fastest
* Stay close to the competitive landscape and ensure Datacom's positioning is sharp, honest, and compelling


**Making Datacom Teams Love What You Build**
* Partner closely with our Teams to ensure AI products are easy to understand, easy to position, and easy to sell
* Create the collateral, the narratives, and the proof points that gives teams genuine confidence in the field
* Be accessible — the kind of product leader who shows up to client conversations, supports bids, and helps close deals
* Gather post\-sale and post\-launch feedback relentlessly — and use it to make things better


 AI Technology — Know Enough to Matter
   

  

 You don't need to be the best data scientist in the room. But you do need to be the person who knows when something is genuinely promising and when someone is selling you a dream. In this role, you'll be surrounded by people who live and breathe AI technology — and by senior stakeholders who will expect you to hold your own in every conversation.
   

  

**Technology Credibility**
* Maintain a deep enough understanding of AI/ML, LLMs, foundation models, and agentic systems to make sound technology judgements
* Know how to spot a bad idea — whether it's an overhyped vendor pitch, an architecture that won't scale, or an automation play that solves the wrong problem
* Engage authentically with Datacom's technical AI teams — earning their respect not through authority, but through genuine understanding and intellectual curiosity
* Be the person who asks the right questions in a technical discussion and knows what to do with the answers


**Agentic AI \& Automation**
* Understand the shift happening right now toward agentic AI — multi\-agent systems, autonomous workflows, and AI that doesn't just respond but acts
* Drive Datacom's capability in intelligent automation — including document processing, workflow automation, conversational AI, and process intelligence
* Oversee the integration of LLMs, RAG pipelines, and agentic frameworks (AutoGen, LangChain, CrewAI) into Datacom products and client solutions
* Ensure Datacom's AI technology choices are sound, scalable, secure, and commercially sensible


**Staying Current — For Real**
* This is a field that moves fast. Really fast. You'll need to invest the time to stay genuinely current — not just across headlines, but across the technology, the vendors, the research, and the use cases
* Be the person in the room who has already read the paper, tried the tool, and formed a view — not the one catching up
* Build a culture of continuous AI learning across Datacom — because your credibility as Head of AI LAB depends partly on the capability of the team and organisation around you


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Senior leadership experience in AI, technology, or a related field — with the scars to prove it
* Extensive Product Knowledge in a corporate or enterprise scaled environment \- it is fine to have come through an entrepreneurial pathway BUT we need you to have that enterprise product understanding and experience in tandem.
* A natural relationship builder — someone who can work a room, navigate resistance, and build trust across every level of a large organisation
* Real commercial instincts — you understand what makes a product succeed, how to take it to market, and what sales teams need to win
* Genuine technical credibility in AI — not necessarily the deepest technical expert, but someone who has done the work to understand the technology and keeps doing it
* Comfort presenting and influencing at General Manager, Executive, and Leader level — clear, confident, and able to simplify without dumbing down
* Experience in complex, matrixed organisations where you've had to lead through influence rather than authority
* A bias for action — someone who moves things forward, makes decisions with imperfect information, and learns fast


 Why Datacom?
   

  

 At Datacom we value our people and provide a collaborative environment that supports career development and growth.
   

  

 We offer:
   

  

* Flexible \& hybrid working arrangements
* Competitive salary \+ company benefits
* A genuinely senior platform to shape AI across one of ANZ's largest tech companies
* The complexity, scale, and ambiguity that makes a role like this worth doing
* A diverse and inclusive culture where different perspectives are not just welcomed — they're needed
* Real career development and the support to keep growing

title: Catastrophe Analyst
description:
**Introduction**
 Welcome to Gallagher \- a global community of people who bring bold ideas, deep expertise, and a shared commitment to doing what’s right. We help clients navigate complexity with confidence by empowering businesses, communities, and individuals to thrive. At Gallagher, you’ll find more than a job; you’ll find a culture built on trust, driven by collaboration, and sustained by the belief that we’re better together. Whether you join us in a client\-facing role or as part of our brokerage division, our benefits and HR consulting division, or our corporate team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, make an impact, and be part of something bigger. Experience a workplace where you’re encouraged to be yourself, supported to succeed, and inspired to keep learning. That’s what it means to live The Gallagher Way.
   

  

**Overview**
**Gallagher Re** 
 is a global reinsurance firm working across the full risk and capital spectrum.
   

  

 We help clients make sense of complexity with our purpose to bring clear thinking and fresh insight to an industry that never stands still. Our clients need more than just execution. They look to us to challenge assumptions, spot what’s coming next and add real value.
   

  

**About The Job**
 In this role, you will combine deep expertise in data analytics and natural perils risk to generate insights that help our clients make smarter portfolio management and risk transfer decisions. You will work at the intersection of science, data, and client advisory, contributing to both technical excellence and commercial outcomes. As our team works across multiple disciplines the role can be adapted to meet your skill set with training provided to support ongoing career development.
   

  

 Depending on your particular experience, the role will typically include:
   

  

* Delivering catastrophe analytics to clients and prospects, including loss modelling and broader advisory to help organisations understand and manage risks from natural hazards and climate change.
* Working closely with broking teams to translate modelling outputs into clear, actionable insights for reinsurance markets and support the placement of catastrophe reinsurance.
* Analysing large and complex datasets using tools such as Python, SQL, and business intelligence platforms (e.g. Power BI) to uncover trends and drive decision\-making.
* Using catastrophe models and Geographic Information Systems (GIS), both commercial and in\-house tools, to assess hazard exposure and accumulation risk.
* Contributing to cutting\-edge research on natural perils (e.g. flood, earthquake, cyclone, bushfire), either independently or in collaboration with colleagues across the business.
* Providing real\-time analysis and reporting during natural hazard events, and support post\-event client engagement through insights, reporting, and presentations.
* Collaborating with regional and global teams to develop and implement new initiatives, with opportunities for international engagement.
* Contributing to business growth by supporting proposals, tender responses, and broader sales and marketing activities.
* Driving operational efficiency and innovation by identifying opportunities to improve processes and support the team’s financial performance.


**About You**
 We are seeking an individual with:
   

  

* A degree in a numerate or hazard\-related discipline such as mathematics, data or spatial science, climate science, earth science, seismology, atmospheric science, geography, meteorology, or a related engineering or analytical field.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, with keen attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
* Proven ability to manage projects and prioritise effectively.
* Ability to quickly interpret, process, and creatively analyse data.
* Comfortable engaging directly with clients and keen to build strong working relationships.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong proficiency in SQL along with advanced skills in MS Excel and intermediate proficiency across the MS Office suite.
* Experience with Python or similar programming languages.


 Proven experience in the following areas is beneficial but not essential:
   

  

* Prior knowledge of reinsurance and catastrophe modelling, including competency in RMS, AIR and other catastrophe risk software packages.
* Experience using Geographical Information Systems (GIS).


**How to Apply \-** 
 Apply via our careers website or for further information, please contact our Talent Acquisition team at careers@ajg.com.au
   

  

**Gallagher Benefits – we offer great benefits and career development opportunities:**
* Continuous learning and development to build a personalised career pathway
* Competitive remuneration and incentive package
* Flexible working options
* Salary sacrificed additional Lifestyle Leave and Superannuation
* Gallagher Rewards and discounts at 350\+ major retailers
* Employee Stock Purchase Plan to invest and share in company's growth potential
* Paid Volunteering days each year


*Any offer of employment and subsequent continuing employment is dependent upon the completion of relevant pre\-employment background checks. All applicants are required to undergo employment screening through probity checks prior to commencing.*
 Gallagher is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to the principles of workplace diversity and inclusion. We welcome all people regardless of ethnicity, faith, sexual orientation, gender identity and lifestyle choices.
   

  

**Compensation And Benefits**
 On top of a competitive salary, great teams and exciting career opportunities, we also offer a wide range of benefits.
   

  

 Below are the
 **minimum core benefits** 
 you’ll get, depending on your job level these benefits may improve:
   

  

* 4 weeks annual leave plus up to 2 weeks additional purchased Lifestyle Leave
* Novated Leasing opportunities
* Two paid volunteer days annually
* Health Insurance Discounts with our Group Insurance Plan
* Employee Stock Purchase Program
* Paid parental leave


**Other benefits include:**
* Flexible and hybrid work arrangements
* Mental Health and Wellbeing Support for yourself and immediate family members
* Employee Recognition Awards and Service Milestone Recognitions
* Peer Support Program
* Annual flu vaccinations
* Access to Reward Gateway – discount offers at over 350 retailers!
* And more...


**We value inclusion and diversity**
 Inclusion and diversity (I\&D) is a core part of our business, and it’s embedded into the fabric of our organization. For more than 95 years, Gallagher has led with a commitment to sustainability and to support the communities where we live and work.
   

  

 Gallagher embraces our employees’ diverse identities, experiences and talents, allowing us to better serve our clients and communities. We see inclusion as a conscious commitment and diversity as a vital strength. By embracing diversity in all its forms, we live out The Gallagher Way to its fullest.
   

  

 Gallagher believes that all persons are entitled to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any form of discrimination by its managers, employees, vendors or customers based on race, color, religion, creed, gender (including pregnancy status), sexual orientation, gender identity (which includes transgender and other gender non\-conforming individuals), gender expression, hair expression, marital status, parental status, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, medical condition, genetic information, veteran or military status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected (herein referred to as “protected characteristics”) by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
   

  

 Equal employment opportunity will be extended in all aspects of the employer\-employee relationship, including, but not limited to, recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, transfer, demotion, compensation, benefits, layoff, and termination. In addition, Gallagher will make reasonable accommodations to known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified person with a disability, unless the accommodation would impose an undue hardship on the operation of our business.

title: Data & Analytics Engineer
description:
**National Breast Cancer Foundation (NBCF)**
 The National Breast Cancer Foundation (NBCF) is Australia's leading not\-for\-profit organisation funding world\-class breast cancer research towards their vision of Zero Deaths from breast cancer.
   

  

 Since their inception in 1994, NBCF has invested over $200M into more than 600 world\-class research projects across Australia. In this time, death rates from breast cancer in Australia have improved by 40%.
   

  

 They’ve seen remarkable results, but the job’s not done.
   

  

 At NBCF, they’re determined to create a better tomorrow. They know research matters, and it is central and critical to improving breast cancer outcomes. That’s why they fund the very best breast cancer research in Australia through a rigorous national grants program.
   

  

 With a talented and committed team and an enviable reputation, NBCF is well positioned to accelerate impact and shape the future for everyone diagnosed with breast cancer.
   

  

**The Role**
 NBCF are seeking a
 **Data \& Analytics Engineer** 
 to play a critical role in shaping and delivering their evolving data platform. This position will design and build scalable data solutions that enable smarter, faster, and more impactful decision\-making across fundraising, finance, and operations.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role suited to someone who enjoys both technical delivery and working closely with stakeholders to translate business needs into robust data solutions.
   

  

**Working Within The Data \& Insights Team, You Will**
* Design, build and maintain scalable data pipelines across CRM, fundraising and marketing systems
* Integrate and transform data into clean, analytics\-ready models within an Azure\-based platform, transitioning to Snowflake and dbt
* Develop automation solutions using SQL, Python and orchestration tools to streamline workflows
* Build reusable data models and semantic layers that power self\-service analytics and consistent reporting
* Support data retrievals for Fundraising and Marketing campaigns
* Collaborate across teams to ensure efficient, secure and high\-quality data flows
* Champion strong data quality, governance and best practice across the organisation
* Contribute to ongoing data platform modernisation and continuous improvement initiatives


**About You**
 You are a technically strong and commercially aware data professional who enjoys solving complex problems and making data meaningful for the business.
   

  

**You Will Bring**
* Experience in a data engineering or analytics engineering role
* Strong skills in data modelling and transformation
* Advanced SQL skills and hands\-on experience with ETL tools (e.g. dbt or similar)
* Experience with Python or another scripting language for automation
* Exposure to modern cloud data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) and data architecture evolution
* Experience building data models and working with BI tools (Power BI preferred)
* Experience integrating data from CRM, finance or marketing systems
* Understanding of APIs, workflows and system integrations
* Experience with data quality, governance and metadata practices
* A collaborative mindset with the ability to engage both technical and non\-technical stakeholders


 You will thrive in a purpose\-driven environment where your work directly contributes to meaningful outcomes.
   

  

**Why Join NBCF?**
* Be part of a mission\-driven organisation making a tangible difference
* Work with a passionate, high\-performing and collaborative team
* Opportunity to shape and modernise a growing data function
* Flexible, supportive and inclusive workplace culture
* Contribute directly to improving outcomes for people affected by breast cancer


**How to Apply**
 To be considered for this position, please apply now with your resume directly through the advertisement along with a tailored cover letter.
   

  

 For further information, please contact Orla Minogue at orla.minogue@beaumontpeople.com.au.
   

  

 Applications will be assessed as they are received.
   

  

 At Beaumont People, we believe a diverse workplace is a happy workplace, and we love working with organisations that feel the same way. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and people with disabilities.
   

  

 We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital or parental status. Should you require any reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process, please let us know how we can support you.

title: Senior Consultant / Manager - Advanced Data Analyst - Planning and Infrastructure Economics
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------


KPMG’s Planning and Infrastructure Economics (PIE) team works at the intersection of policy, capital and technology. We help governments, regulators, investors and infrastructure providers navigate complex reform, investment and pricing questions across the energy sector and other regulated industries.


Our team is embedded within KPMG’s Infrastructure, Asset \& Places group, a national team of global infrastructure specialists. Our differentiator is our experience across the full infrastructure project lifecycle and our close connection with KPMG’s wider specialised services, offering unique opportunities to work together with a broad range of clients and industries, deepening and strengthening client relationships.

**Job Description**
-------------------


We have multiple roles for highly skilled Spatial Data Scientist / Analyst / Modellers to join our Planning and Infrastructure Economics team. The ideal candidate brings strong technical capability in GIS, Python, and R, combined with experience in spatial analytics, web technologies, and applied AI (including large language models or agentic/vibe coding approaches).


We currently have a range of exciting, nationally significant engagements and opportunities including:

* Many of Australia’s largest and most complex transport projects
* Renewable/clean energy projects and energy transition initiatives
* Socially impactful projects and reform initiatives in health, social \& affordable housing, education and justice
* Significant property transactions and precinct planning and development activities

 **Your opportunity**


We are seeking **Advanced Data Analysts / Modellers** across **Senior Consultant and Manager** levels.


As a member of our high\-performing team, you will:

* Design and implement scalable spatial and economic data models to support infrastructure and planning analysis.
* Conduct advanced spatial, statistical, and economic analysis using GIS, Python, R, and SQL to generate actionable insights.
* Develop robust demand forecasting models across transport, land use, social infrastructure and energy systems to inform planning and investment decisions.
* Build and deploy spatial tools and applications (e.g. web apps, dashboards, APIs) to support investment, policy evaluation, and planning outcomes.
* Integrate datasets across land use, transport, energy systems, demographics, and economics to support scenario testing and decision making.
* Apply AI techniques, including large language models and agentic coding approaches, to streamline workflows, automate analysis, and enhance insight generation.

* Work within multidisciplinary teams, including planners, transport specialists, energy analysts, and economists, to deliver integrated solutions.
* Communicate insights clearly through maps, models, dashboards, and written outputs tailored to both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Stay current with emerging practices across spatial analytics, infrastructure economics, demand forecasting, and smart cities.

 **Skills and Experience:**

* Proven experience working with spatial data and GIS platforms (e.g. ArcGIS, QGIS, PostGIS).
* Strong programming capability in Python and/or R, with experience handling large and complex datasets.
* Experience developing demand forecasting models (e.g. transport demand, land use forecasting, energy demand forecasting) or similar analytical frameworks.

* Experience developing spatial tools or applications using web technologies (e.g. JavaScript, APIs, Shiny, or similar frameworks).
* Demonstrated experience applying AI or machine learning, ideally including large language models or agent\-based or agentic workflows.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure complex, multidisciplinary problems.
* Excellent communication and visual storytelling skills, particularly using spatial outputs and economic narratives.
**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Spatial Data Science, Geoinformatics, Engineering, Economics, Urban Planning, Computer Science, or a related field.

KPMG is a professional services firm with global outreach and deep sector experience. We work with clients across an array of industries to solve complex challenges, steer change and enable growth.

title: Energy Market Analyst / Modeller
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission\-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting\-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
   

  

 Your impact
   

  

 Jacobs’ Energy \& Power Advisory team sits at the forefront of the energy transition, helping clients navigate complex, rapidly evolving electricity and gas markets across APAC. We combine deep market expertise with advanced quantitative modelling to deliver strategic insights on market behaviour, investment decisions, policy, and system transformation. Our work spans power market analytics, regulatory design, decarbonisation pathways, and commercial advisory, supporting governments, developers, investors, and utilities to make confident, future focused decisions.

title: Head of Data
description:
**The Role**
 We are seeking a dynamic,
 **hands\-on** 
 Head of Data who will lead our data organization from vision and through delivery and operations. This person works closely with Product, Engineering, Design, the Leadership Team, and other stakeholders, and will both set strategy
 *and* 
 roll up their sleeves when needed to drive a fast moving, dynamic product and growing Data organisation in the AI era.
   

  

**What You'll Do**

* Define and drive the company\-wide data strategy end\-to\-end, from how raw data is collected until it’s used in user\-facing AI features or for internal decision making.
* Ensure teams at Linktree have the capabilities to make sound data\-driven decisions and build the platforms and frameworks to hold teams accountable to high standards in decision making.

**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate on budget, resource allocation, technology investment decisions.

**Team Building, Mentorship \& Management**
* Build, grow, and mentor senior leaders, both as managers and ICs. Ensure strong leadership across your team.
* Recruit and retain top data talent, help define hiring strategy, interviewing, and onboarding.
* Ensure our teams leverage data to its full potential to make sound data\-driven decisions and foster a culture of learning, decision quality, ownership, psychological safety, and accountability.
* Lead adoption of AI\-driven tools to drive productivity and ensure we’re on the forefront of modern engineering and product building workflows.


**Process, Governance \& Scaling**
* Establish best practices across the entire data lifecycle (instrumentation, data engineering, insights, experimentation, ML and AI validation) and the frameworks to hold teams accountable to these practices.
* Maintain effectiveness and reliability of AI and user\-facing insights solutions by establishing monitoring, alerting and remediation processes.
* Continuously partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate and evolve the cross\-functional product org structure to match the company’s growth, ensuring clarity of ownership, effective collaboration, and decision\-making velocity.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Linktree has a unique value proposition in the market due to data and AI\-driven capabilities.
   

  

* Decision making throughout the organization is based on sound insights.
* Team attrition is healthy, team members are growing in their roles and the management pipeline is strong.
* Stakeholders (Product, Customers, Execs) trust data and insights.
* The data function is a key partner in business decision making, not just a delivery engine.
* You’ll work directly with the CEO, who is product\-led and values data as a thought partner, not just a delivery function.


**What You'll Bring**
* 12\+ years in data\-related fields, such as data science, data engineering, ML engineering with at least 5\+ years leading managers or directors in growing, fast\-paced environments.
* Track record of designing and launching large scale user\-facing data or AI driven product capabilities with measurable impact.
* Track record of transforming organisational culture to become data driven, including self\-service insights and experimentation.
* Deep technical expertise in data science, ML, AI as well as relevant engineering aspects such as data and AI platforms.
* Proven track record of direct contributions at technical level, even as leader.
* Excellent leadership, mentoring, and people\-management skills; ability to recruit and retain strong talent.
* Strong collaboration, communication, ability to simplify \& explain technical issues to executives and cross\-functional teams.
* Preferred / Nice\-to\-Haves
+ Experience scaling teams across multiple geographies
+ Prior experience in Saas / Consumer tech


*Linktree is committed to providing a fair and competitive compensation package including cash, equity, and benefits. title: Product Designer (Platform)
description:
**About Revolut**
People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75\+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning\-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000\+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

**About the role**
The Product team shapes the experiences that power Revolut. They turn complex problems into simple, scalable solutions, collaborating across Design, Engineering, and Data to build features our customers love.


We're looking for a Platform Product Designer to build internal systems and tools that enable us to operate at scale.


You'll turn fragmented workflows into structured and scalable solutions for business\-critical areas, including AI tooling, customer support platforms, financial infrastructure, and internal back\-office systems.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

**What you'll be doing*** Designing complex internal platforms and tools for global operations, support, compliance, and AI workflows
* Architecting large\-scale systems, mapping end\-to\-end behaviours, states, and interactions across multi\-step processes and edge cases
* Building scalable UI/UX patterns while balancing speed, usability, and technical constraints in internal tools
* Turning ambiguous, fragmented, or highly technical requirements into clear product logic and usable interfaces
* Partnering with Product Owners, Engineers, Data Scientists, and Operations Managers to unify product logic
* Identifying bottlenecks in internal processes and redesigning them for scale and performance

**What you'll need*** 3\+ years of experience designing world\-class products in\-house, ideally internal tools or platform experiences
* A portfolio featuring examples of complex product or systems design work
* Impressive design skills across web platforms
* The ability to think at a high level about product strategy and articulate design decisions
* A solid understanding of technical implications in design decisions, including backend\-driven workflows
* The ability to take ownership of design processes
* A focus on UX and an understanding of how operational users behave
* To be comfortable designing data\-heavy interfaces, including complex states, tables, and dense workflows
* Knowledge of typography and grids

**Nice to have*** A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or related technical field
* Programming skills and the ability to code simple prototypes
* Expertise in designing and maintaining cross\-platform design systems
* Experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment
* Familiarity with Android and iOS

*Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D\&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard\-working team.*

*Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.*

* ***Only apply through official Revolut channels.*** *We don’t use any third\-party services or platforms for our recruitment.*
* ***Always double\-check the emails you receive.*** *Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.*

***We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.*** *If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.*

**About Opendoor**
 At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end\-to\-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.
   

  

****Data Scientist, Pricing****
*****Location: Hyrbrid 4 onsite, 1 remote*****
**Seattle WA.**
 Opendoor is transforming one of the largest, most complex markets in the world — residential real estate — using data at massive scale. Every pricing signal we generate directly impacts how we value homes, how we manage risk, and how efficiently capital moves through our marketplace. The work is highly leveraged: the quality of our pricing decisions influences conversion, margins, customer trust, and the company’s financial performance.
   

  

 We are looking for mid to senior level Data Scientists. In this role, you will be a core driver of how Opendoor prices real estate at scale. You’ll operate at the intersection of economics, machine learning, experimentation, and product strategy — tackling ambiguity, shaping the pricing roadmap, and building models/analyses that materially move the business. Your insights will influence how we evaluate millions of dollars of housing inventory — and directly shape outcomes for our customers, our balance sheet, and the health of our marketplace.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build and maintain pricing metrics, dashboards, and frameworks.
* Run experiments and causal analyses to measure impact and drive decisions.
* Develop predictive \+ statistical models that improve pricing accuracy.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to influence roadmap and model deployment.
* Deliver insights and narratives that inform executive strategy.


**Skills \& Qualifications**
* Deep statistical reasoning: hypothesis design, experimental design, causal inference, and ability to distinguish signal vs noise.
* Proven end\-to\-end ML ownership: data acquisition, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring.
* Strong SQL \+ Python proficiency; comfortable working with production data pipelines and modern ML tooling (e.g., Spark, Airflow, Ray, SageMaker, Vertex, etc.).
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations and influence cross\-functional decision\-making.
* Experience working with ill\-defined problems and driving clarity on problem definition, success metrics, and realistic tradeoffs.
* High data\-quality bar: disciplined approach to validation, bias analysis, and making decisions rooted in evidence vs intuition.
* Effective communicator — able to tell the story behind the model to both highly technical and non\-technical audiences.
* 8\+ years of experience in data science, product analytics, or a similar quantitative role.


 \#
   

  

**The Pay Range For This Role Is**
 169,600 \- 233,200 USD per year(US Zone 2\)

description:

We have also been named a 2026 FICO Industry Vanguard Decision Award Winner. Last but not least, we’ve even made history \- we were the first company to go live with the eCBSV and testified before the United States House of Representatives on the future of identity.
   

  

 SentiLink supports a variety of ways to work, ranging from fully remote to in\-office. We operate as a digital\-first company with strong collaboration across the U.S. and India. We maintain physical offices in Austin, San Francisco, New York City, Seattle, Los Angeles, and Chicago in the U.S., and in Gurugram (Delhi) and Bengaluru in India. If you’re located near one of these offices, we would love for you to spend time in the office regularly. Some roles are hybrid or in\-office by design. For example, our engineering team in India works primarily from our Gurugram office.
   

  

**Role**
 As a Data Scientist at SentiLink, you will build our core products: models that identify fraudsters and also advance our growing suite of products in financial risk. This role is designed for new PhD graduates or early\-career researchers interested in applying machine learning to real\-world fraud detection. You'll build and ship machine learning models in a production environment, gaining hands\-on experience across the full ML lifecycle, from research and development to deployment at scale. If you're looking for real\-world AI and ML exposure in an industry setting, not just research papers, this is it.
   

  

**We Have Open Roles On Multiple Teams Including**
* Emerging Products \- focuses on 0\-to\-1 development of new offerings brought to market

 You will be relied upon to be technically capable and the definitive owner of your respective domain. You will often work on projects with high visibility and impact that require deep domain understanding, critical thinking and strong technical abilities. You will work with teams across the company to research new types of fraud, develop new products, and provide analysis to drive sales and marketing. This is a full\-stack data science role, involving model development, analysis, and writing production code. You should be interested in having end\-to\-end ownership and a fast\-moving environment where deep domain understanding drives development and unusual insights drive our competitive advantage rather than optimization of new machine learning methodologies.
   

  

 This role can be remote within the U.S., with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our
 **Austin, San Francisco, or New York** 
 offices.
   

  

**Technologies:** 
 Python 3, PostgreSQL, and AWS infrastructure (EC2, S3, RDS, Redshift, etc.)
